sidebars.body_markdown: Compensation = (Listing price − Issue price) × (Shares that would have been allotted) × (Probability of allotment). The listing price is the highest opening price on listing day across all exchanges. No compensation if listing price is below issue price. For issues subscribed 90%–100%, the applicant is compensated for all shares they would have been allotted.
sidebars.rationale: Formula is too dense for prose; sidebar isolates it for quick reference.
